portalsFound.observation: NLA site links the RSDI portal geodata.rw and the Rwanda Land Dashboard.

"Rwanda Spatial Data Infrastructure" ArcGIS Enterprise; its catalogue lists 29 public district parcel services under LAISData plus "Parcels of first registration" (hosted service returned "not found" at test time).

Folders basemap, CORS, FilePub, Forest, Hosted, LAIS, LAISData, masterplan, Overlays, ParTes, Settlement, SPR, Test, Utilities; LAISData currently exposes only Bugesera_Parcels and Kigali_Parcels as running services.
NLA ArcGIS Online account publishes 19 district *_Parcels feature services publicly (plus DLUP land-use plans and dashboards).
Shiny dashboard; data delivered over a websocket, no reusable service URL.
